controls.title: No hardcoded secrets in code or versioned config
controls.objective: Verify no password, key or token is written in clear text in source or versioned config.
controls.test_procedure: 1. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files. 2. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(?i)(password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|aws_secret|token)\s*[:=]\s*['"][^'"]+ with path_prefix app/ and without prefix. 3. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/config.py and any matched files to inspect context. 4. Verify secret access uses os.environ, os.getenv or vault client and no clear-text value.
controls.expected: Zero hardcoded secret assignments; all secrets obtained from vault or environment variables.
controls.risk: Credential theft and unauthorized access to production and payment data.
controls.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets and load them from a vault or environment variables.
controls.cause: Developer convenience hardcoding credentials for local testing.
controls.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

controls.title: TLS certificate verification never disabled
controls.objective: Verify no outgoing call disables TLS server certificate verification.
controls.test_procedure: 1. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*False. 2. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=ssl\._create_unverified_context|CERT_NONE|check_hostname\s*=\s*False. 3. Review matched files via GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to confirm context of requests, urllib3 or http client calls.
controls.expected: Zero matches for verify=False or equivalent TLS verification bypass.
controls.risk: Man-in-the-middle interception of SEPA transfer data.
controls.recommendation: Enforce TLS verification on all outgoing calls and remove any verify=False.
controls.cause: Disabled verification to allow self-signed certificates in test.
controls.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).

controls.title: Approved password hashing only
controls.objective: Verify passwords use argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 and no MD5 or SHA-1 for security.
controls.test_procedure: 1. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2|passlib|hashlib. 2. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=hashlib\.(md5|sha1)\(|\.md5\(|\.sha1\(|MD5|SHA1. 3. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<matched file> to confirm password-hashing context versus non-security use.
controls.expected: Password hashing uses only argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2; zero use of MD5 or SHA-1 for security.
controls.risk: Password cracking and credential compromise due to weak hashes.
controls.recommendation: Migrate password hashing to argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 and remove MD5/SHA-1.
controls.cause: Legacy code using hashlib MD5/SHA-1 examples.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

controls.title: CI runs static security analysis on every change
controls.objective: Verify CI executes bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on each change.
controls.test_procedure: 1. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list .github/workflows/. 2. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/ci.yml (and any other yml) to inspect triggers and jobs. 3. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=bandit|semgrep|codeql|CodeQL to confirm tool invocation.
controls.expected: A workflow triggered on push and pull_request runs bandit, semgrep or CodeQL.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL to CI on every push and pull request.
controls.cause: Security scanning omitted from pipeline configuration.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

controls.title: Pinned dependencies audited in CI
controls.objective: Verify exact version pinning and CI dependency audit.
controls.test_procedure: 1. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=requirements.txt to verify every entry uses == with exact version. 2. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree for .github/workflows and read workflow files. 3. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=pip-audit|pip_audit|safety|osv-scanner to confirm audit step in CI.
controls.expected: All requirements pinned as package==version; CI runs pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.risk: Supply-chain compromise via unpinned or vulnerable dependencies.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies with == and add pip-audit or equivalent to CI.
controls.cause: Use of floating version ranges without vulnerability scanning.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

controls.title: Synthetic test data only
controls.objective: Verify test data is declared synthetic and no production export is versioned.
controls.test_procedure: 1. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list tests/ and fixtures. 2. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=synthetic to verify presence of "synthetic": true. 3. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<fixture file> to confirm declaration. 4. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=prod|production.*dump|real.*iban|export.*prod to flag suspected production exports.
controls.expected: Test data files contain "synthetic": true; zero versioned production exports.
controls.risk: Leak of real customer data in non-production via versioned exports.
controls.recommendation: Replace test data with synthetic data marked "synthetic": true and remove production exports.
controls.cause: Copy of production data committed for realistic testing.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

controls.title: Authentication successes and failures logged
controls.objective: Verify the application logs both successful and failed authentications.
controls.test_procedure: 1. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=log.*auth|auth.*log|login.*(success|fail)|logger\.(info|warning|error). 2. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<matched auth file> to confirm both success and failure branches emit a log event.
controls.expected: Code contains logging for both authentication success and authentication failure events.
controls.risk: Undetected brute-force or account takeover due to missing audit trail.
controls.recommendation: Add logging for both authentication successes and failures.
controls.cause: Incomplete logging with only errors or no auth events logged.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
